scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only firestore --project demo-sevenfriends-test "npm --prefix functions run test:run"
scripts.android:sync: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend exec cap -- sync android
scripts.ios:sync: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend exec cap -- sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm --prefix frontend exec cap -- open ios
scripts.android:open: npm --prefix frontend exec cap -- open android
